localChanges: In Civilization II games, computer players now build warships and submarines. Their warships hunt your ships, sail alongside their own loaded transports and bombard coastal cities (#1128).
Computer players in Civilization II games also build fighters, bombers, helicopters and cruise missiles to attack your units and cities, and drop paratroopers into undefended cities (#1124).

In Civilization II games, aggressive computer leaders may now build the Manhattan Project and use nuclear weapons on the cities of a civilization they are at war with, unless SDI Defense protects them (#1124).

log: An aggressive computer leader wants the Manhattan Project once it knows Rocketry (AF2, civ-clone/web-renderer#1124) (#6)
Warships, submarines, aircraft, missiles, nuclear weapons and paratroopers where the rule set's roles name them (AF, civ-clone/web-renderer#1128, #1124) (#95)
Warships per body of water, aircraft only at seen cities, and only an aircraft that reaches (Copilot on civ-clone/web-renderer#1171) (#97)
